lina: Heads-up: drafting a short partner SEV flow for marketplace + HW + SI partners. Goal: predictable handoff w/ minimal noise.

noah: good. high-level?

lina: 4 steps: 1) signal (partners-oncall ping + minimal card), 2) verify (partner ack and must-call if HW flagged), 3) triage (shared channel war room for 30m), 4) handback (ticket + postmortem owner).

tomas: suggest adding a fallback matrix: if no partner ack -> Redwood oncall -> vendor-relay. Also include required artifacts: top-3 logs, deploy id, model/version, region.

lina: agreed. sample activation syntax: /partner-alert partner=EdgeCloud sev=sev1 customer=BigBank must-call=true fallback=redwood-oncall

partners-oncall-bot: Channel created: #orbit-BigBank-EdgeCloud. Escalation card pinned.

noah: add response SLAs: sev1 ack <10m, sev2 <30m. If missed, escalate to fallback. Also run tabletop with 2 partners next Friday.

lina: I'll post the runbook and PR for the bot command. tagging vendor-relations for review. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
